the last page

For my favourite person ♡

Gudunn,

I know I don't always get everything right, and sometimes I probably make things way more complicated than they need to be. 😭 But one thing I never want you to doubt is how special you are to me.

Thank you for the little things, the extra efforts, the random smiles, the support, and for being there even when I'm being an absolute mess.

I can't promise I'll never mess up, but I can promise that I'll always care about you, appreciate you, and want to make you feel loved.

You're not just another person in my life. You're my favourite notification, my comfort person, and one of my safest little corners of this chaotic world. 🥹
